# Steve Pallett

Steve Pallett is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2011.

Steve Pallett has participated in 6 elections since 2002:

- [**2005 St Brelade Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett#e26)

  Not elected.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett#e7)

  Not elected.
- [**2011 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett#e14)

  Elected as Connétable of St Brelade with 54.6% of the vote.
- [**2014 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett#e21)

  Elected as Connétable of St Brelade unopposed.
- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett#e41)

  Elected as Senator with 44.8% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/steve-pallet-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=icdBxK9O6JI)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZWXsvDZAF1c)
  - [2018 ITV Video](http://www.itv.com/news/channel/2018-04-10/jsy2018-stevepallett/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/steve-pallett/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XgfXB710dBQ)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5d2346b25e98b80001fb6187/t/628d51f8e8bc456c68603980/1653428728890/Steve+Pallett+Deputy+St.+Brelade+JEA+Questionnaire.pdf)

Steve Pallett has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Brelade](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade). \[[bailiwickexpress.com](https://www.bailiwickexpress.com/news/return-of-the-mac-and-a-former-constable/)\]

- Twitter : [@pallett\_steve](https://twitter.com/pallett_steve)

**Steve Pallett was not elected**.

| 3 | ~~[Sarah Ferguson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sarah-ferguson)~~ |  | Withdrew |  |

### 2011 Connétables Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Brelade](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade) (1 seat), 7th September 2011.

**Steve Pallett was elected as Connétable of St Brelade in 2011**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Steve Pallett** |  | 1,999 | 54.6% |
| 2 | [Mike Jackson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-jackson) |  | 1,665 | 45.4% |

3,664 votes

7,641 registered voters

= 48% turnout
